[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is the principle element to form a state?","marks":1,"answer":"The principal element of forming a state is sovereignty.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Explain any one of the elements of the state.","marks":2,"answer":"One of the essential elements of a state is government. The government is the machinery through which the state exercises its authority, enforces laws, administers public policies, and maintains order. It consists of institutions such as the legislature, executive, and judiciary. Without a government, a state cannot function or implement its sovereignty effectively.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which concept of your textbook has been reflected in division-A of the stem? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"The concept in Division A is directly connected to the duties and responsibilities of citizens as described in the textbook. A balanced relationship exists between the rights provided by the state and the responsibilities owed by its citizens. Division A reflects this relationship by highlighting two fundamental civic responsibilities: loyalty to the state and the obligation to pay taxes.
Loyalty to the state involves showing obedience and dedication to national policies and laws, which helps maintain order and unity. Citizens are encouraged to remain vigilant for the security and sovereignty of the nation, ready to act in its best interest, especially during times of national need. Furthermore, regular tax payments represent an essential contribution that citizens make to support the government’s functions. Taxes are crucial for funding state operations, including public services, infrastructure, defense, and other development projects that improve the quality of life for all. Thus, Division A emphasizes that fulfilling these core responsibilities—both in terms of loyalty and financial support—reflects a citizen’s commitment to the welfare and progress of their country.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Division-B of the stem is essential for the existence of any state-give your opinion about the statement.","marks":4,"answer":"Division B is indeed essential for the existence of any state, as it reflects core duties that a state must fulfill to maintain its structure, stability, and independence. The mandatory or prime activities ensure a state’s security, authority, and external relationships, all of which are fundamental for its survival and functioning.
To maintain law and order, a state enforces laws, protects citizens from crime, and ensures a safe environment, fostering trust in the government and preventing chaos. National security, independence, and sovereignty are equally vital; they protect a country from foreign threats, preserve its territorial integrity, and allow it to operate independently without external interference. Additionally, adopting a foreign policy enables the state to build international alliances, safeguard its interests abroad, and engage in trade and diplomacy, which are necessary for economic growth and influence on the global stage. Without these essential functions, a state would risk instability, internal conflict, or even dissolution, as it could neither protect its citizens nor assert its place among other nations. Thus, Division B’s elements form the backbone of a functioning state, enabling it to serve and protect its population effectively.

[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Write down the definition of a citizen according to Aristotle.","marks":1,"answer":"As per Aristotle, the father of Political Science, “Who participates in the administration directly and represents in the city state is called Citizen”.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Why is it a moral responsibility of citizens to prevent corruption and misdeeds?","marks":2,"answer":"It is a moral responsibility for citizens to prevent corruption and misdeeds because they are well-wishers of the country. The construction of metro rail is an infrastructural development project aimed at improving public transportation and facilitating mobility. Such projects fall under the state’s welfare functions, which focus on long-term development and public convenience, even if they cause temporary inconveniences.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Explain the authenticity of the debate topic mentioned in the stem.","marks":4,"answer":"The topic of the debate mentioned in Scenario 2 – “The principles of law ensures good governance” – is justified. Law means the known and accepted forms of written and unwritten norms of a country. The execution of law minimize criminal acts in a society and ensure social security and peace. In the Scenario 2, this exact thing is mentioned.
It is very important to have principles of laws to have good governance. Usually, the principles of laws expresses two thoughts. One is the equality of all in the eyes of law. The government cannot be reckless if the principles of laws are prevailing. To detain someone for no reason and keep someone arrested without proper charges are contradicting to the principles of laws. At the same time, the government cannot interrupt someone’s privacy for no good reason. Besides, equality means everyone is equal irrespective of their rich-poor, strong-weak, nation, religion, race, cast and other identities. So, the same law is applied for all. Apart from the main two thoughts of the principles of laws mentioned above, there are few more factors of the principles of law that are important to maintain good governance. Only making or passing a law is not enough. Imposing these rules by a responsible authority of the state is also important. Laws are created to control the external behaviours and work of the people. One must obey that to stay safe and to be loyal to his/her state. People who breaks or disobeys laws are supposed to be punished. When the implementation of law goes uninterrupted, there are less chaos and disobedience of law. When this happens, the state is known as the state of good governance.
In the end we can say that “The principles of law ensures good governance” is a justified statement.
---","image":null,"image_url":null}]

Those citizens of the state who are intelligent, conscientious, self-restrained, and can sacrifice their little interests for the greater good are considered good citizens. The three main virtues of a good citizen are intelligence, conscience, and self-control. A good citizen shows loyalty to the state, abides by the existing laws and constitution of the state, pays taxes on time, and sacrifices his own interests for the greater good of the state. A good citizen enjoys rights from the state as well as fulfills responsibilities and duties towards the state.
The qualities of a good citizen are absent in Mr. ‘U’ in the passage. Although the income he receives from salary and house rent is taxable, he does not pay taxes properly. This means that he is not performing duties in exchange for the rights granted by the state. By doing so, he is neglecting his legal duty towards the state. If the supremacy of law prevails, the government cannot be autocratic and abuse power.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which element is indicated by the marked? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"The marked ‘?’ in the passage indicates sovereignty, which is one of the elements of the state. Every state consists of four essential elements. Such as the people, the specific geographical territory, the government, and the sovereignty. The principal element needed to form a government is sovereignty. The meaning of the word ‘sovereignty’ is the highest and absolute power. The formation of the state becomes complete when sovereignty is ensured. This power distinguishes the state from other organizations. In each social system, there will be a central authority that will exercise supreme power. And this power is the sovereign power. The idea of sovereignty is the law, which everybody is bound to obey. Therefore, it can be said that to form a state, sovereignty is necessary.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Do you think that a state cannot be formed without the mentioned element". Evaluate with argument.","marks":4,"answer":"Yes, I think that without the element mentioned, which is sovereignty, a state cannot be formed. The principal element for the formation of government is sovereignty. The meaning of the word ‘sovereignty’ is the highest and absolute power. It means that in each social system, there will be a central authority that will exercise supreme power. And this power is the sovereign power. The sovereign power has both inner and outer entities. By exercising its inner power, the state establishes its supremacy over all its citizens and organizations. No authority can exist over this sovereign power. The meaning of outer sovereignty is that the state will be free from the control and influence of outside power in the international arena. If any state has citizens, specific territory, and a government but lacks sovereignty, it will not be recognized as a state.
In general, state means government, society, or community. After analyzing the concept of state, we find four elements that have been mentioned in the chart given in the passage. If any one of these four elements is missing, a state is bound to lose its status.
From the above discussion, it is clearly evident that the absence of the four elements of the state affects the other elements. Therefore, it can be said that without the essential element of sovereignty among the four elements of the chart, it is not possible to form a state.

Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"Through incident-1, the source of law that is expressed is 'The Precedence of Court'. There are several sources of law. Political scientist Holland mentions 6 main sources of law. Among these, the Precedence of the Court is a source of law. If the conventional law does not seem sufficient to complete the judicial work, the judge works according to his own experience. This instruction is evident in incident-1 of the stem.
Mr. Shahid is a Judge of the High Court in the incident-1 of the stem. He judges according to the existing law. Recently, he performed judicial work in light of his long experience of not getting the clarity of the law regarding a case. It refers to the sense of justice. During the trial, if the judge fails to settle the case through the conventional law, then with the help of his intelligence, talent and wisdom, he gives the judgment with a new interpretation of the law in accordance with the conventional law. It becomes a precedent and eventually becomes a law. So it can be seen that the judge's verdict is also a source of law.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Do you think that it is possible for the citizens like Mr. Badshah to establish good governance? Justify your answer.","marks":4,"answer":"Yes, I agree with Mr. Badshah's statement that it is possible to establish good governance in a state by fulfilling the responsibilities of citizens.
As the state provides various facilities to the citizens, so the citizens also have to fulfill some responsibilities and duties towards the state. The main duty of a citizen is to show loyalty to the state. Obeying the laws and constitution of the state, voting for the eligible person, maintenance of children, performing work related to the interest of the state, paying rent and taxes, patriotism etc. are among the responsibilities and duties of the citizen. If these responsibilities are fulfilled, the wheels of the economy of the state are in motion and everything can run smoothly in the state.
Mr. Badshah of the stem avoids contradictory imports and exports, pays regular taxes and votes for eligible persons. These activities are the responsibility of every citizen. It is the sacred responsibility and duty of a citizen to vote with such honesty and discretion. As a result, qualified and suitable candidates will be elected as public representatives and work to build a corruption-free country. Every citizen should be motivated by patriotism. Corruption and injustice should be protested in various cases. It is the moral responsibility of the citizen to stand against any illegal act of individuals or institutions or even the state. This is how a state is established as a corruption-free and beautiful country. Mr. Badshah of the stem performed the mentioned tasks.
From the above discussion, it can be said that the rights of citizens in the state will be guaranteed in fulfilling various duties of citizens like Mr. Badshah. In this way, it is possible to establish good governance in a state.
---","image":null,"image_url":null}]

[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Define law according to Woodrow Wilson.","marks":1,"answer":"In the definition of law, Woodrow Wilson said, ‘Law is that portion of the established habit and thought of mankind which has gained distinct and formal recognition in the shape of uniform rules backed by the authority and power of the government’.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"What do you mean by rule of law? Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"The provision of equal rights to all citizens in the eyes of the law is called the rule of law. The rule of law is very important in establishing good governance in the state. Once the rule of law is established in the state, all citizens can equally enjoy the freedom and facilities provided by the state. No one can violate the right of law. Generally, the rule of law expresses two concepts. Namely: supremacy of law and equality of all in the eyes of law. If the rule of law is maintained, the government cannot be arbitrary.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"What kind of activities done by the state? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"The state undertakes both mandatory (essential) and optional (welfare) activities. Mandatory activities include maintaining law and order, protecting sovereignty, and ensuring national security. Optional activities include providing education, healthcare, infrastructure development, and social welfare programs like disaster relief and rehabilitation.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Do you think that the activity of the state mentioned in the stem is not sufficient for state? The functions of the state referred to in the stem are optional work of the state. The government has extended its hand of cooperation to stand by the people in the flood-affected areas and worked there to build dams and rehabilitate the victims. The state must play a benevolent role in the full development of human life for the overall betterment of society. Apart from all these functions, the state has some essential functions.
All the steps taken by the state to maintain the existence of the state, protect the integrity of independence-sovereignty, and preserve the rights of the people are called essential or main tasks. The main functions of the state include maintaining law and order, ensuring the safety of life and property of citizens, guaranteeing the protection of personal freedom, forcing the people to obey the law, and punishing criminals or violators of the peace. For this purpose, the state created police and other para-military forces to maintain law and order. These forces prevent any conflict situation.

Such citizens help build a stable, progressive, and just society.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Following which qualities one general citizen can develop himself into a good citizen? Discuss.","marks":3,"answer":"To be a good citizen one must have these three qualities intelligence, conscience, and self-restraint. An intelligent citizen can easily identify and solve multifaceted problems of family, society, and state. A good citizen is conscientious. He can perceive right and wrong, right and wrong, good and bad, and refrain from doing wrong. Besides, Good citizen is self-restrained. He keeps himself above all kinds of greed and fulfills his duties with honesty and devotion, abandoning his own petty interests for the larger interests of society and the state. A good citizen always plays a role in the welfare of the state and society. Intelligence, conscience, and self-restraint make an ordinary citizen a good citizen.
Those citizens of the state who are intelligent, conscientious, self-restrained, and can sacrifice their petty interests for the greater good are considered good citizens. A good citizen's main virtues are intelligence, conscience, and self-control. A good citizen expresses loyalty to the state, abides by the prevailing laws and constitution of the state, pays taxes on time, and sacrifices his petty interests for the greater good of the state. A citizen enjoys rights from the state as well as responsibilities towards the state.
An ordinary citizen can become a good citizen when he can manifest the three virtues of intelligence, conscience, and self-restraint in himself through self-sacrifice and action. An intelligent citizen can identify the multifaceted problems of the family, society, and the state and make sound decisions in solving them. Conscientious citizens enjoy the privileges provided by the state as well as fulfill their responsibilities and duties towards the state. Before doing any work, the work will not be bad for society and the state. A citizen due to self-restraint keeps himself above all kinds of greed and fulfills his duties and responsibilities with honesty and devotion. Sacrificing his own petty interests for the greater good of the society.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"How a good citizen can play his role to contribute for his country? Put your own opinion.","marks":4,"answer":"A good citizen contributes to the country by performing his duties and responsibilities properly.
A citizen enjoys all the facilities provided by the state and fulfills his duties and responsibilities towards the state. As the state provides various privileges and rights to the citizens, the citizens also have to fulfill some responsibilities and duties towards the state. The main duty of the citizen is to show loyalty to the state i.e. obey the instructions of the state. Besides, every citizen should always be vigilant and ready to make extreme sacrifices to protect the security, integrity, freedom, and sovereignty of the state. It is one of the responsibilities of the citizen to obey the existing laws and constitution of the state and show respect for the law. If someone disobeys the law, chaos occurs in the society. Normal life is disrupted. Therefore, every citizen must obey the law to live a fair life and maintain peace and order. Besides, voting should be done with honesty and fairness to elect suitable candidates as public representatives. Citizens should cooperate in government work by paying taxes and fees on time. The responsibility assigned to the state should be properly performed. Everyone should be motivated by patriotism and wish the country well. Every citizen should protest against corruption and injustice in various fields.
Finally, a good citizen can contribute to the country through the activities discussed above.

[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Who is called a citizen?","marks":1,"answer":"The citizen is the person who is bound to discharge duties and responsibilities of the state on the other hand enjoy all civic and political rights.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Explain that each child is a child of the state.","marks":2,"answer":"It is said that every child is a child of the state because of the state’s responsibility towards the citizen. Parents care for their children to provide for their basic needs and overall security. In the same manner, it is the duty of the state to provide for the basic needs and security of its citizens. Just as parents treat all their children with equal love and compassion, the state is committed to providing every citizen with equal civil benefits without discrimination.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"What type of activity of the state is similar to Mr. Sadat’s work? Explain it.","marks":3,"answer":"There are similarities between the actions of Mr. Sadat with the optional or welfare tasks of state. For the welfare and development of people, the tasks that the state performs are called optional or welfare tasks. The most important work of this state is to educate its people. The state’s educated citizens are its most valuable resource. The educated are aware of the citizen’s rights, duties, and responsibilities and are encouraged to be patriotic. The state gives much importance to the development of education. The state also plays a significant social role in the healthcare of its citizens. The state also establishes and runs hospitals, free medical centers, mother and child healthcare centers, family planning centers, and temporary health camps around the country to ensure healthcare services for its citizens and arrange treatment facilities for the patients. Besides providing services to ensure health care for its people, the state also arranges pure drinking water, a sewerage system, disease prevention measures, and an immunization program.
From scenario-1 of the passage, it can be seen that Mr. Sadat arranged a hospital for the health care of the people of the area and a playground for sports. He also established a library to encourage everyone to read. These functions are similar to the optional or welfare functions of the state described above. Because such work is not essential for the state. That is why, it can be said that the actions of Mr. Sadat are similar to the optional or welfare functions of the state.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"“The concept of law that is reflected in scenario-2 is very much important in establishing good governance.” Analyze.","marks":4,"answer":"In scenario 2, it is reflected that in the eyes of the law, everyone is equal. To ensure good governance, this idea of a law is important. The law is universal. It is equally applicable to everyone in the state. No one will get extra facilities under the law. In the eyes of the law, equality is an important matter. The freedom of the law is hampered in a state when the rules of the law do not exist. That is why, to maintain equality and discipline, everyone is seen equally in the eye of the law.
It is seen in the passage that ‘X’ is arrested by police, despite being rich and powerful, for harassing a female college student. He is sent to prison as punishment. This reflects equality in the eyes of the law.
The necessity of the law is very important for good governance. If law and order prevail in a state, every citizen can enjoy freedom and the benefits provided by the government. Nobody can harm the rights of others. Usually, the rule of law expresses two concepts: (a) the supremacy of the law and (b) the equality of everyone to the law. If the supremacy of the law prevails, the government cannot be autocratic and usually cannot abuse power. Arresting anyone without any crime or confiscating and punishing anyone without trial is contrary to the rule of law. The supremacy of the law is the protection of the freedom of the citizen. Nobody can interfere in others affairs if the supremacy of the law prevails in society. The government does not dare interfering in the freedom of anyone’s life without any logic. The meaning of equality in the eyes of the law means everyone, irrespective of religion, cost, creed, color, community, or being rich or poor, is the same. The same law is applicable to all. Therefore, when the rule of law is established, establishing good governance is easy.
At last, it can be said that establishing good governance becomes easier if the rich and the poor, the strong and the weak, regardless of caste, religion, or color, enjoy equal benefits in the state through the proper application of the law.","image":null,"image_url":null}]
